root_causes: Wrong object instance: the agent manipulated toy_vehicle_1 instead of the specified task object toy_vehicle_0, indicating confusion between similarly-typed objects.

Partial goal satisfaction: only the toy animal was successfully relocated and placed (2/4 propositions complete); the toy vehicle was never correctly placed on the table to satisfy the goal conditions.

Poor inter-agent coordination: Agent 0 kept holding the toy vehicle while Agent 1 tried to execute the placement of the toy animal next to it, leading to an inconsistent and incomplete final configuration.
Ineffective replanning: multiple replan cycles (P4, P5) repeated similar actions without correcting the incorrect object choice or explicitly resolving remaining unmet propositions.
Termination despite unmet goals: the episode ended with only 50% task completion, suggesting the stopping condition did not reliably depend on all goal predicates being satisfied.
improvement_suggestions: Enforce strict object identity tracking so that planned actions must reference the exact task objects (toy_vehicle_0, toy_animal_2) rather than any object of the same category.
Incorporate a final goal-verification step that checks all task predicates (vehicle on table, animal on table, next_to relation, construction set unchanged) before allowing episode termination.

Improve multi-agent coordination policies so that when one agent holds a task object, it is responsible for completing all related placement actions or explicitly hands it off before another agent plans around it.

Refine replanning logic to detect stagnation (repeated similar actions with no increase in completed propositions) and trigger higher-level plan revision that re-evaluates object selection and remaining goals.

Add explicit checks to ensure that no non-task objects are used to satisfy task predicates, and that holding states (e.g., agent still holding toy_vehicle_1) are resolved to a stable placed configuration.
overall_assessment: The agents partially completed the task by correctly placing the toy animal, but failed to correctly place the designated toy vehicle and ended the episode with only half of the required conditions satisfied. Execution showed clear issues in object identity handling, coordination, and goal checking.
task_instruction: Help me tidy up the bedroom. Move the toy vehicle and toy animal from the chest of drawers to the table. Place them next to each other. Leave the toy construction set where it is.
